list: Official PlayStation 5 list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written for this tracker in our own words and cites where each fact comes from.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 · balcony & fishing
roadmap.summary: Play the opening chapter. Take Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house after Down to Earth and keep a manual save before the chapter ends.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 · partner, garages, Kingpin
roadmap.summary: Partner switching opens, the Real Estate and Scooter Bros apps unlock, and the optional Kingpin Bowling job appears.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 · Vice City crime tools
roadmap.summary: Yasmani's jobs give the Snap Gun and the Dye Pack Jammer; race Yago when his timed race appears.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 · bank vaults
roadmap.summary: The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vaults; start the five-vault run.

roadmap.title: Main story missions & finale
roadmap.summary: Named story missions and the final mission unlock automatically; none can be missed, but there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Character strands
roadmap.summary: Finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, Bret's hunt and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands; they stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.summary: Meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicle discoveries and the full map.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.summary: Stunts, Shooting Range golds, Top Fun drone races, races, arcade and Challenges.

roadmap.title: Free-roam crimes & oddities
roadmap.summary: One-off crimes, hidden moments and spending goals; several triggers are still unconfirmed.

roadmap.title: 100% & Platinum
roadmap.summary: Close out the in-game 100% checklist; the Platinum follows the 54th trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.location: Pops by itself once the other 54 are earned; single-player only.
trophies.guide: Nothing extra to do: it is the reward for the other 54. Guides agree on one playthrough of roughly 200 hours, no difficulty or online trophies, and a 4/10 difficulty, with only Positive Mental Attitude at risk [3][4][5].

steps.text: Work through the Roadmap tab stage by stage: story first, then strands, collectibles, activities and cleanup.
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Never enter cheats on your trophy save; they switch off trophies and saving while active.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.location: The opening mission; you cannot skip it.
trophies.guide: The first trophy of the run: it unlocks on finishing the opening mission of Chapter 1, and guides list every story trophy as impossible to miss [3][4].

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
Make your first manual save right after it, so Chapter 1 can be replayed from here.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.location: Pops at the start of Chapter 2, after its first mission.
trophies.guide: Earned for closing out Chapter 1; PowerPyx notes it actually pops once the first Chapter 2 mission is done. Before you cross that line, finish Lucia's balcony meditation, the one thing guides say Chapter 1 can take from you [3][4][8].

steps.text: Before the last Chapter 1 mission, take the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save from late Chapter 1 in a slot you never overwrite.
Finish the chapter and the first mission of Chapter 2; the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.location: Pops after the first Chapter 3 mission.
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 is where the tracker's side work opens up: partner switching, the garage and Scooter Bros apps and the Kingpin Bowling job. The trophy itself is automatic when the chapter wraps [3][5][8].

steps.text: While in Chapter 2, start garage buying and vehicle registration (Little Boxes, On the Spot).
Take the optional Kingpin Bowling job when it appears (Let's Go Bowling).
Finish the chapter; PowerPyx says the trophy pops after the first Chapter 3 mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.location: Pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions.
trophies.guide: An automatic chapter trophy. Chapter 3 is worth slowing down in: Yasmani's jobs hand you the Snap Gun and Dye Pack Jammer, and Yago's race there is timed [3][5][8].

steps.text: Do Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to get the Snap Gun (Sneakthief) and Dye Pack Jammer (Dime on the Dollar).
Race Yago as soon as his race shows up; it can expire.
Finish the chapter and the opening Chapter 4 missions to unlock it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.location: Pops after the last Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 brings the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which opens the bank vaults; do it before pressing on so the vault trophies are in reach. The chapter trophy is automatic [3][4][5].

steps.text: Accept the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock bank vaults.
Save, then play the final Chapter 4 mission; the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.location: The last story mission; free roam continues afterwards.
trophies.guide: The story's gold. Free roam carries on after the credits, so nothing else is lost by finishing, but Game-Checklists suggests wrapping up partner trophies and one-character strands first in case the ending limits who you can play [3][8].

steps.text: Before the finale, finish Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best and the Andy, Bret and Tyrone strands.
Make a dedicated save just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission; the gold pops at its end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.location: Main story mission; unlocks automatically.
trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy that cannot be missed. Output Lag ties partner switching to this mission, while other guides point to Coffee Break, so expect the partner trophies to open around here [5][6][8].

steps.text: Play the main story until Breakfast Run and complete it.
From here, check whether you can switch partners; if not, it opens with Coffee Break.

differs.call: Both fall in Chapter 2; plan partner trophies for after Coffee Break to be safe.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.location: Main story heist; unlocks automatically.
trophies.guide: Guides group it with the story-mission trophies that unlock on their own as the plot moves along; none of the launch guides we read says which chapter holds this heist, so we do not guess [3][4][8].

steps.text: Follow the main story until The Cartel Heist and finish it.
No choices or ratings affect the trophy; there are no mission medals.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.location: Main story mission; unlocks automatically.
trophies.guide: Another automatic story-mission trophy. Game-Checklists lists it among the six that pop through the main missions with no risk [3][8].

steps.text: Keep playing the story; finish Child's Play when it comes up.
Rotate between two or three manual saves so a bad autosave never costs a chapter.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.location: Main story mission; unlocks automatically.
trophies.guide: Story-mission trophy for Headliners. It cannot be missed, and guides note there are no gold-medal ratings to chase on missions, so any clear counts [3][5][8].

steps.text: Reach Headliners in the main story and see it through.
No mission score matters: GTA VI has no mission medals.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.location: Main story mission at Vice City International Airport; automatic.
trophies.guide: Unlocks when the VCIA Takedown story mission is done. Not to be confused with Catch Me If You Can, a separate free-roam plane theft at the same airport [3][5][8].

steps.text: Play the story through VCIA Takedown.
Later, return to VCIA in free roam for the plane theft trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.location: Main story mission; automatic.
trophies.guide: The last of the six named story-mission trophies. Like the others it pops on completion and is listed as unmissable by every guide we read [3][4][8].

steps.text: Continue the story through Operation Savage Glory.
Tick it here; the Roadmap then moves you on to the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.location: Progress › Stats › 100% Completion checklist (opens after the story).
trophies.guide: Rated the hardest trophy, mostly for time. The checklist is lenient (about 60% of all content): 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 stunts, but every robbery type, underwater find, range gold and drone trial in full [3][4][6].

steps.text: Open the 100% checklist after the credits and work down each category.
Do all of: 8 vaults, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 39 gang operations, 33 underwater finds, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 15 Target Decks.
Partial items: 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 70/80 Challenges, 15/18 meditations, 300/397 stunts, 30/40 races.
Nothing on the list is missable, though some optional missions vanish for a while mid-story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.location: 397 stunts across Leonida; tracked under Progress › Activities.
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts. PowerPyx splits them into 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up. Go to 300 if you want them to cover the 100% list too [3][4][6].

steps.text: Grab a fast plane and chain under-the-bridge flights along the rivers and canals.
Fill the gap with stunt jumps you pass while driving.
Stop at 300 rather than 250 so A Long Road's stunt line is done too.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.location: Nine activity types spread over the map.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one go at each: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race or drone race, and a stunt. Most come up naturally on the way to other trophies [3][4].

steps.text: Use the counter: one tick per type (fishing, hunting, golf, range, pool, basketball, video game, race/drone race, stunt).
Pool and golf are the ones players usually skip; seek them out once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.location: Shooting ranges; 42 challenges in total.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 range challenges, which the 100% list also wants. Sources agree on 42 medals but not on how many ranges host them [3][4][5].

steps.text: Buy the best version of each weapon class before attempting its challenges.
Work through all 42 challenges; replay any silver until it turns gold.

b.text: The 42 golds are spread over two ranges.

differs.call: The 42-gold target is agreed; we track that and leave the range count open.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.location: 14 Top Fun drone race locations (42 time trials in all).
trophies.guide: Fly a drone race to victory at each of the 14 locations. Each location hosts three trials (42 total), and guides read the requirement differently, so the box below shows both [3][5][6][7].

steps.text: Visit all 14 Top Fun locations and win at least one race at each.
For A Long Road you will need all 42 trials anyway, so finish each location while you are there.

differs.topic: How many races the trophy needs

a.text: One win per location, 14 in total.

b.text: Lists the requirement as 42 races across the 14 locations.

differs.call: Wording says 'at every location', so 14 wins; doing all 42 covers both readings.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.location: 40 unique race locations across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Twenty distinct race wins out of 40 race locations; repeat wins on the same course do not add up. The 100% list asks for 30, so keep going past 20 [3][4][7].

steps.text: Bring a well-upgraded car; win 20 different races (repeats don't count).
Push on to 30 wins and 10 race-challenge golds for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.location: Fishing spot west of Key Lento, marked by Cal's text.
trophies.guide: Cal texts you a fishing challenge after the Feng Shui mission; PowerPyx says it marks a spot west of Key Lento. Out-fish him there to unlock it [3][5].

steps.text: After Feng Shui, read Cal's text and travel to the marked spot west of Key Lento.
Win the fishing challenge against Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.location: Three games on the home TV; Bang For Your Buck in arcades.
trophies.guide: Beat every level of any one of the four video games; their side challenges are optional. Three are on the TV at home, the fourth in arcades. All four are on the 100% list later [3][4][5].

steps.text: Pick one game on the home TV (or Bang For Your Buck in an arcade).
Clear all its levels; challenges inside the game are not needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableWhen: Andy's strand is Lucia-only. Not missable per PowerPyx, but Game-Checklists advises finishing one-character strands before the final mission in case the ending limits who you can play.
trophies.location: Andy's marker appears in Chapter 3; five missions, Lucia only.
trophies.guide: Andy's five-mission strand is for Lucia alone and shows up in Chapter 3. PowerPyx calls it not missable; Game-Checklists still suggests finishing it before the finale, so we flag it as one to watch [3][8].

steps.text: As Lucia, take Andy's first mission once his marker appears in Chapter 3.
Complete all five; the trophy pops at the last.
Aim to finish before the final story mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.location: Kenton's treasure hunts: seven shipwrecks dug up with the metal detector.
trophies.guide: Kenton sends you after seven shipwrecks that you dig up with a metal detector. He disappears for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back, so the strand cannot be lost [3][4].

steps.text: Meet Kenton early; expect him to go quiet after Chapter 1.
When he returns, use the metal detector to find his shipwrecks and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.location: Mud club in Kelly County; five missions.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is five missions starting from the mud club in Kelly County. It has its own trophy and, per PowerPyx and Output Lag, does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [3][5].

steps.text: Head to the mud club in Kelly County to pick up Billy's strand.
Finish all five missions for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableWhen: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) and This is a Free Call From… are timed and can expire. Game-Checklists lists the trophy as at risk; Output Lag only says to do Yago's race when it appears.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: Watch: timed Yago race in Chapter 3
trophies.location: Stranger markers across Leonida; strands with their own trophies do not count.
trophies.guide: Eight qualifying stranger strands. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count and says Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Two missions are timed, which is why one guide marks it at risk [3][5][8].

steps.text: Do Yago's race the moment it appears in Chapter 3; it is timed.
Do the call mission This is a Free Call From… when offered; it can expire too.
Finish 8 strands from Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and the other strangers; skip Andy, Billy and Tyrone for this count.

a.text: At risk: a timed Yago race and a timed call mission can expire.

b.text: Not listed as missable; just do Yago's race when it appears.

differs.call: Treat as WATCH: do both timed missions on sight and you are safe either way.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.location: Randy in west Vice City; cars often parked around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Randy hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver. PowerPyx suggests the Key Cloner and hunting around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where those cars tend to spawn [3][10].

steps.text: Meet Randy in west Vice City to start his list.
Clone keys and deliver all 16 cars; count them here.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableWhen: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. Game-Checklists suggests finishing one-character chains before the finale in case the ending restricts characters.
trophies.location: Jason only; destroy the Synthetic Labs, then the mission Spin On This.
trophies.guide: Jason's strand for Tyrone: wreck the Synthetic Labs he points you at, then finish the closing mission that shares the trophy's name [3][8].

steps.text: As Jason, take Tyrone's missions and destroy every Synthetic Lab.
Complete the mission Spin On This to finish the strand.
Do it before the final story mission to be safe.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableWhen: Meditation #1 is Lucia's balcony session at Jason's house, offered the morning after Down to Earth and gone once Chapter 1 ends. No guide has confirmed it is required, so do it anyway.
trophies.location: Jason's balcony (Ch 1) · 8 outdoor spots × Jason and Lucia · Ascent, Mount Kalaga summit.
trophies.guide: The only trophy launch guides flag as possibly missable. Beebom counts 18 meditations: the Chapter 1 balcony, two each (Jason + Lucia) at Smooth Sand, Buckskin Swamp, Camp Moonflower, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall and Seaside, and a final Ascent on Mount Kalaga that appears once the rest are done [3][4][9].

steps.text: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, join Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house and finish the session.
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Visit the 8 outdoor spots with both Jason and Lucia (16 meditations).
Finish with the Ascent spot on Mount Kalaga's summit, which needs both characters.

a.text: Missable for good: the balcony is meditation #1 of 18 and disappears after Chapter 1.

b.text: Only possibly missable: the balcony did not show as a counted spot, so it may not be needed.

differs.call: POSSIBLY missable. Do the balcony in Chapter 1 and the question never matters.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableWhen: Bret's hunting chain is Jason-only; Game-Checklists lists it among single-character chains to finish before the final mission.
trophies.location: Starts with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County; Jason only.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting questline is for Jason and opens with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Which unique animal ends it is not yet published in the guides we read [3][5][7].

steps.text: As Jason, start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Follow Bret's hunts until he sends you after the unique animal, and bring it down.
Finish before the final mission in case the ending limits characters.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.location: 18 card sets exist; any 3 complete sets count.
trophies.guide: Three complete card sets out of 18. The 100% list later wants 15 of 18, so finishing sets as you find them pays off twice [3][4].

steps.text: Collect cards as you explore; focus on finishing whole sets rather than spreading out.
Three full sets unlock the trophy; keep going to 15 for 100%.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.location: Any eligible WAiNK spot; more than 100 exist.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game WAiNK app at 100 different eligible places. There are more than 100, so no single spot is ever critical; KeenGamer suggests scanning as you play the story [3][4].

steps.text: Open WAiNK whenever the prompt appears on your travels.
Count scans here; 100 unique locations unlock it.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.location: Progress › Challenges menu; 80 in total.
trophies.guide: Fifty of the 80 Challenges, tracked under Progress › Challenges. A Long Road needs 70, so the trophy comes on the way [3][4][5].

steps.text: Check Progress › Challenges and pick off the ones that match what you are already doing.
Reach 50 for the trophy, then 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableWhen: Needs your partner alongside you. Game-Checklists advises doing partner trophies before the final mission in case the ending changes who you can play.
trophies.location: Anywhere after partner switching; a train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a suggested hideout.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner in tow, then leave the red heat zone; it only pops once you are out of it. Vault jobs give 4 stars on their own, and PowerPyx and eGamers suggest hiding in a train tunnel north of Ambrosia [3][5][6][7].

steps.text: With your partner along, rob a vault or cause trouble until you hit 4 stars.
Break line of sight and get clear of the red heat zone; a train tunnel north of Ambrosia works.
If the stars drop too early, reload and retry.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableWhen: A partner trophy: Game-Checklists suggests finishing it before the final mission.
trophies.location: Three shops close together; PowerPyx suggests the north Vice City jewelry stores.
trophies.guide: Call in your partner, rob one shop and keep the stars while you hit two more. Three neighbouring stores in north Vice City are a good chain. Guides disagree on what to do if it does not pop straight away [3][5][6][7].

steps.text: With your partner, rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Drive straight to the second and third shops; north Vice City has three close together.
If it hasn't popped, see the box below before robbing more.

differs.topic: Trophy did not pop after shop 3

a.text: Wait about 30 seconds; it can be slow to pop.

b.text: Rob a fourth shop (eGamers citing GTABase).

differs.call: Wait 30 s first; a fourth shop costs nothing if it still hasn't popped.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.location: Busy roads; vehicles are discovered by scanning them with WAiNK.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. eGamers says scanning passing traffic with WAiNK beside a busy road is quickest; the 100% list later asks for 200 of 277 base models [4][5][7].

steps.text: Park by a busy highway and scan passing cars with WAiNK.
Reach 100 for the trophy; carry on to 200 base models for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.location: Any gang fight; gang members are the reliable targets.
trophies.guide: Fill your Combat Focus meter, trigger it in a fight with a group of gang members and drop five before it runs out. Guides say police, soldiers and civilians do not count, and an assault rifle makes it easy [3][5][7].

steps.text: Pick a fight with a gang crew, not police or soldiers.
With a full meter and an assault rifle, trigger Combat Focus and drop five quickly.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.location: Vice City International Airport, boarding bridges at gates E3/E4.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at one of VCIA's boarding bridges (E3 and E4 are named) and fly it roughly a kilometre away. Expect a wanted level the moment you board [3][5][6][7].

steps.text: Go to VCIA terminal E and board a jet parked at gate E3 or E4.
Taxi out, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.location: South side of Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County.
trophies.guide: Break into Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County, take one of the Rhino tanks parked on its south side and fire on enemies from inside it [3][4][5][7].

steps.text: Approach Mile Zero Air Station's south side, where tanks are parked.
Climb into a Rhino and use its cannon on the soldiers that respond.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.location: Any jewelry store back door; needs the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs.
trophies.guide: Once Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun, pick a jewelry store's back lock, find the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted [3][5][6][7].

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to earn the Snap Gun.
Use it on a jewelry store's back door; find the safe code in the back room.
Open the safe and leave unseen; reload if an alarm trips.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.location: 8 bank vaults across Leonida, opened by the Ch 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: The optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the large bank vaults. Robbing and escaping from any 5 of the 8 earns it; eGamers' method is to tail a security van in while the vault stands open. All 8 are needed later for 100% [4][5][6][7].

steps.text: In Chapter 4, complete That's Where The Money Is…
Follow a security van into a bank while the vault is open; expect 4 stars on the way out.
Escape cleanly five times; do all 8 if you are going for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.location: Armored trucks on the road; unlocked through the Chapter 4 vault mission.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get away. Output Lag stresses it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just in the flashing search area; Timesaver says a Pay 'n' Spray also works [3][5][6].

steps.text: After the Chapter 4 vault mission, find and rob an armored truck.
Drive clear of the red heat zone until the stars go.

a.text: You must leave the red heat zone; the flashing search area is not enough.

b.text: Leaving the heat zone or reaching a Pay 'n' Spray both count.

differs.call: Leave the zone fully; it satisfies both readings.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.location: The whole map: clear every patch of fog.
trophies.guide: Remove the fog from the entire Leonida map. Flying a plane over the remaining dark patches late in the run is the fastest cleanup, per PowerPyx and eGamers [3][4][7].

steps.text: Let the map fill naturally during the story and strands.
Then fly a plane low over any fogged areas until none remain.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.location: 39 gang operations owned by 9 gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 in total and A Long Road wants all of them, so clearing them area by area covers both [3][4][5][6].

steps.text: Tick one gang here each time you rob a new gang's operation.
Do all 39 operations eventually for the 100% list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.location: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach (per PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Only PowerPyx gives a method so far: order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it beside the bar. KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed, so treat this as single-source [3][4].

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it next to the bar, facing the view.
If nothing pops, check back here: the trigger is unconfirmed elsewhere.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.location: Vehicle showroom in south Vice City (per PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: steal the blue Banshee on display in the south Vice City showroom and drive it out through the front window; it says only that car works. KeenGamer and Timesaver call the method unconfirmed [3][4][6].

steps.text: Enter the south Vice City showroom and get into the blue Banshee.
Drive straight through the glass window to leave.
Other guides have not confirmed this yet; mark it here once it works for you.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.location: Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn; optional Chapter 2 job Hit Kingpin Bowling.
trophies.guide: Take the optional Chapter 2 job at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, grab all three valuables and lose the police. Output Lag and PowerPyx both say it is not missable; Game-Checklists notes the safe can be blown open later if you skip it [3][5][6][8].

steps.text: Accept Hit Kingpin Bowling when it appears in Chapter 2.
Steal all three valuables inside.
Escape the police to finish.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableWhen: Needs both Jason and Lucia. Game-Checklists suggests finishing it before the final mission.
trophies.location: Fitness clubs; work out together after Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Max the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Guides recommend training together at a gym once partner play is open, so both bars rise at once [3][4][5][6].

steps.text: After Chapter 2, take both characters to a fitness club.
Work out together until both Strength stats are full.
Do it before the final mission, to be safe.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.location: Anywhere: actions that change your Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. Output Lag and PowerPyx expect it to fill on its own during a normal run, so there is nothing to grind deliberately [3][4][5][6].

steps.text: Play normally; crimes and choices feed the Criminal Profile.
If it hasn't popped by the cleanup stage, check the profile and add a few more actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.location: Unconfirmed; PowerPyx mentions a possible Payday Loans store in Little Cuba.
trophies.guide: No guide we read has a confirmed method yet. PowerPyx floats an unconfirmed lead involving a Payday Loans store in Little Cuba; the official hint suggests doing something a second time. Derived from the official description until confirmed [3][4][6].

steps.text: Unconfirmed lead: try robbing the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba twice.
Check back after an update; no confirmed trigger is published.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.location: Per PowerPyx: northwest of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2 AM.
trophies.guide: Likely a UFO easter egg. PowerPyx describes going alone at night after 2 AM to an area northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, with a random trigger vehicle; Output Lag only lists two unconfirmed leads, and KeenGamer and Timesaver call it unconfirmed [3][4][5][6].

steps.text: Play solo and wait until after 2 AM in-game.
Go northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look around.
Other guides list it as unconfirmed; retry on different nights.

a.text: A UFO event northwest of the Starlet Motel after 2 AM.

b.text: No confirmed trigger yet; only leads.

differs.call: Unconfirmed: try PowerPyx's spot, but don't count on it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.location: A crowded street, on a bike.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians over with melee kicks from a bike inside 60 seconds; KeenGamer and Timesaver say the exact requirement is not confirmed yet [3][4][6].

steps.text: Get a bike and ride through a busy pedestrian area.
Kick pedestrians over from the bike, aiming for 10 within a minute.

a.text: Kick 10 pedestrians off their feet from a bike within 60 seconds.

b.text: A melee drive-by of some kind; precise count still being confirmed.

differs.call: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx's version also satisfies the looser reading.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.location: Marked bills from bank and payday loan jobs; launder through fences.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; the Chapter 3 Dye Pack Jammer keeps them usable. Launder them through your fence contacts until the running total hits $250,000, which is also a 100% line [3][4][5][6].

steps.text: Earn the Dye Pack Jammer from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs.
Rob banks and payday loan stores for marked bills.
Sell them to fences; log each $1k here until 250.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.location: Any shops; guns, car mods and tattoos add up fastest.
trophies.guide: A cumulative $100,000 across shops. PowerPyx points to weapons, car mods and tattoos as the quickest ways to spend; it will likely come with no effort after the vault money arrives [3][4][5].

steps.text: Spend on weapons, vehicle mods and tattoos as you need them.
Totals carry over between shops; log spending here in $1k steps.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.location: Real Estate app, opened by Chapter 2's Daily Driver; 8 garages, about $160,000.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Real Estate app, which opens with Chapter 2's Daily Driver; together they run about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count [3][5][7].

steps.text: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open the Real Estate app.
Buy the 8 garages as money allows (about $160,000 total).
Ignore the 4 story garages; they are not part of the 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.location: Scooter Bros app, unlocked by Chapter 2's Moses mission; registration with Moses in Port Gellhorn.
trophies.guide: Register 10 cars through the Scooter Bros app, which Chapter 2's Moses mission unlocks. You need free garage space for each one, so buy garages alongside [3][5].

steps.text: Finish Moses's Chapter 2 mission to unlock Scooter Bros.
Steal cars and register them with Moses in Port Gellhorn; you need garage space.
Repeat until 10 are registered; count them here.
